evidence: ADR line 42: '`[non-codebase]` completes that pair with the tag the matcher *does* parse.'
ADR lines 51-53: 'The completion-verdict `kind` value changes in lockstep, from `operator-attested` to `non-codebase` ... only the emitter changes.'
ADR line 85: 'The matcher now accepts exactly TWO tokens — `non-codebase` and `operator-attested` — via a non-capturing alternation.'
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py:45: `r"^\s*-\s*\[[ xX]?\]\s*\[operator-attested\]\s*(.+?)\s*$"` — regex matches only `[operator-attested]`, no `non-codebase` alternation present.

src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md:94-95 still instructs classification 'SOLELY from ... `- [ ] [operator-attested] …`. Matching is exact and case-insensitive on the token `operator-attested`.'; line 224 kind values are `codebase-verifiable` or `operator-attested`.
The change under review contains only docs/adr/* files — no code change to the matcher or prompts accompanies the ADR.
advisory.finding: ADR 0101 states as accomplished present-tense fact that the matcher already parses `[non-codebase]` and that the completion-verdict kind already emits `non-codebase`, but this change is docs-only and the implementation has not landed: the matcher regex still matches only `[operator-attested]` and the verifier prompt still teaches/emits only `operator-attested`. A reader (or author) trusting the ADR would tag `[non-codebase]` today and have it silently fall back to the stricter codebase-verifiable bar.
scenarios: An author reads Accepted ADR 0101, tags an acceptance criterion `[non-codebase]`, and the criterion is silently classified codebase-verifiable, breaking its close path — the exact failure ADR 0043/0101 aim to prevent.
A future maintainer reads the ADR and assumes the matcher/emitter already handle `non-codebase`, then builds on that false premise.
advisory.suggested_fix: Either (a) phrase the matcher/kind/emitter statements as the decided intent ('the matcher will accept two tokens', 'the kind value will change') rather than accomplished fact, or (b) ensure the accompanying implementation commits (regex alternation in _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and prompt updates in completion_verifier.md / plan_review_evidence_kind.md) land in lockstep with the ADR.
